# Plex Gotchas

> Known Plex patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Plex's official OpenAPI spec omits /library/metadata/{ids}/children](official-openapi-spec-omits-children.md): The official PMS spec lacks GET /library/metadata/{ids}/children, which python-plexapi uses for seasons and episodes; do not treat it as the full API surface. MEDIUM.
- [developer.plex.tv/pms has no spec download: extract it from __redoc_state](pms-spec-embedded-in-redoc-state.md): The PMS spec lives in the docs page's __redoc_state; json.dump(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) reproduces openapi.json byte for byte; info.version has a trailing newline. LOW.
- [plexapi `fetchItems([keys])` silently leaves out keys the server no longer has](fetchitems-drops-missing-keys.md): `fetchItem` raises NotFound but `fetchItems` drops the key, so zipping results with keys misaligns without an error; map by ratingKey. HIGH.
- [plexapi `fetchItems` pages at 100 and resends the whole key list on every page](fetchitems-pages-repeat-key-list.md): a long key list costs a request per 100 items, each carrying every key; batch by 100 with `container_size=100` (1,369 episodes: 7.4 s one by one, 1.9 s batched). MEDIUM.
- [Tautulli `get_history`: `start_date` is one day, and ungrouped rows count every resume](tautulli-history-start-date-and-grouping.md): `start_date` filters to that exact date (use `after`), and `grouping=0` splits a resumed play into several rows that inflate play counts; history also has no section id or transcode reasons. HIGH.
- [Jellyseerr auto-approves a request filed with the admin key and a userId](jellyseerr-userid-auto-approves.md): Seerr takes auto-approve from the calling account (the admin for an API key), not the body userId, so such requests skip approval; act as the user with the X-API-User header, and treat its 202 as nothing filed. HIGH.
- [Sonarr's season pass flips only the season's flag; its own page saves the whole series](sonarr-season-pass-leaves-episodes.md): Without monitoringOptions, POST /api/v3/seasonpass leaves the season's episodes as they were; PUT the whole series with the season's flag changed, as Sonarr's page does, and its episodes follow. HIGH.
- [Radarr's release dates are whole days: do not shift them to local time](radarr-release-dates-are-whole-days.md): inCinemas, digitalRelease, and physicalRelease are days at midnight UTC, so converting them to local time moves them a day early west of UTC; Sonarr is the reverse, place episodes by airDateUtc in local time. HIGH.
- [Sonarr's and Radarr's command bodies are not in their OpenAPI specs](arr-command-bodies-not-in-openapi.md): POST /api/v3/command's per-command fields are untyped in the specs (SeasonSearch takes seriesId and seasonNumber, EpisodeSearch and Radarr's movie commands take id lists); read them from each app's web bundle. MEDIUM.
